blindSummary:
This state/province recorded 3 killings of trans and travesti people in 2025 on a population of ~3.6 million - about 0.83 per million per year, more than double the national per-million rate - and the 2024 dossier counted 8 killings here, its highest year. The state/province sits on a frontier agricultural zone, and the dossier's finding that most killings happen outside the capitals means small-town exposure is relevant for visitors travelling beyond the major cities.

Three cases on a small population is statistically fragile, and no qualitative incident, ordinance or enforcement evidence was found beyond the association's counts; the elevated per-capita reading therefore carries a smaller weight than the raw rate suggests.
blindSourceSummaries: The national trans-association's 9th annual dossier (released 26 Jan 2026, reported by a broadcast news outlet): the country recorded 80 murders of trans and travesti people in 2025, 34% down on 2024 but with at least 75 attempted homicides and crimes marked by excessive violence; in the per-state table the top states/provinces recorded 8, 8, 7 and 7 killings and a middle group 5 each, with one further state/province at 2 and this state/province at 3; 1,261 murders over 2017-2025 (avg 140/year); 97% of victims travestis/trans women, over half aged 18-29, 70% of racially-identified cases were from the country's historically marginalised racial groups; 67.5% of killings happened in interior cities rather than capitals, where monitoring, denunciation and access to public policies are harder; the country has led the global ranking since 2008. Lists this state/province at 3 killings for 2025.

Association 2024 dossier coverage (27 Jan 2025): 122 trans and travesti people murdered in the country in 2024, 16% below 2023's 145 and just under the 2008-2024 average of 125; five victims were human-rights defenders, including a city-council alternate; 95.9% of victims were travestis/trans women; the highest state/province tallies were 16, 12 and 11, while three states/provinces recorded none; at least 68% (83 cases) occurred in interior cities outside state/provincial capitals; 1,179 killings confirmed 2017-2024; official statistics are unreliable due to misclassification and underreporting. Supplies the 2024 national reference figures and interior pattern; the year's per-state table places this state/province among the worst performers.
